 Follow Victoria Justice Drops Stunning New Photos & Sends Fans Into a Frenzy
 Manoj Chekkilla Thu, November 12, 2026 at 6:45 PM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Photo Credit: Netflix Victoria Justice 's latest photoshoot photos quickly grabbed fans' attention. The new images also prompted fans to ask about her plans for new music.
 Justice shared the photos on X, showing her in a sparkling, all-black, semi-sheer minidress. She completes the look with a black leather cap, matching gloves, layered jewelry, and glossy thigh-high boots. The former Nickelodeon star captioned the post, "love you to death x," alongside a black heart emoji and a mention of the photographer.
 Justice regularly shares outfit pictures and personal updates with her followers on social media. The 33-year-old recently crossed 1 billion total streams on Spotify across all credits, achieving the milestone without having released a traditional solo studio album.
 Victoria Justice's latest post has fans looking ahead to her music era
 Fans quickly flooded the comments section with compliments for the actress. One fan, @sucker4greedy , wrote, "Victoria, we need that album so bad queen." @DavidAdens2 commented, "Victoria Justice is the most beautiful incredible woman in the world, and I'm so excited that we're getting an album very soon."
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement @justicerusher also expressed similar interest, writing, "We need more music, an album, anything from you please, bestie! Any news for us?" Meanwhile, @osnapitzaridw asked, "We love and miss you, new music soon?"
 However, the comments remain pure fan speculation and don't confirm any upcoming album. Justice first gained recognition for her musical performances as Tori Vega on Nickelodeon's Victorious. The show featured several songs the actress performed, including Make It Shine and Freak the Freak Out.
 She has steadily dropped independent singles over the past few years, including Stay, Too F*ckin' Nice, and Last Man Standing, alongside 2024 tracks like Tripped, Raw, and Down. More recently, she released Love Zombie and Santa Darlin'.
 On the acting front, she recently appeared in Suits LA. Her next project is Send a Scare, a horror-thriller directed by Josh Trank.
 Originally reported on ComingSoon .
